text:
renee_ops: Follow-up from the PM: recurring noisy pages for auth-gateway (403 bursts). Need clear owners for dedupe, thresholds, suppression windows, canary, and monthly churn audit. Tracker: https://go/rems/auth-noise.

josh_oncall: I can take dedupe + suppression. Plan: dedupe key = client_id:path:hash(body,6), suppression window 180s per key. Will prototype in staging.

priya_sre: I'll own threshold tuning and the churn audit. Suggest phased threshold bump (10% then 25%) and adding a global p99 spike alert so we don't hide real incidents.

dan_dev: I'll add the short-hash util and unit tests. Recommend using path + first 48 bytes of body for hash input to reduce collisions. ETA 3d.

infra-bot: Incident record 2027-02-14: auth-gateway auth spike -> 41 pages, peak 02:40 UTC.

emma_prod: For rollout: staging -> canary 5% prod (48h) -> gradual release. I'll coordinate with CS for the noisy clients list.

josh_oncall: Draft alert (staging):
```
alert: AuthGatewayAuthBurst
expr: sum(rate(auth_gateway_responses_total{status=~"4.."}[5m])) by (client_id, path) > 35
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/auth-gateway-403.md"
```
Paging dedupe config: key: "{{client_id}}:{{path}}:{{hash(body,6)}}" suppression_window: 180s

priya_sre: Add a synthetic that simulates the retry loop so we can validate suppression coverage. I'll create dashboard panels (unique dedupe keys, pages/day).

dan_dev: PR for hash util up in draft. Will include canary wiring for CI.

renee_ops: Owners + ETAs: josh (dedupe+suppression) 10d, priya (thresholds+audit) 21d, dan (hash util+canary) 4d, emma (client coord) 7d. Create GH issues tagged pm-followup/alert-tuning and link to tracker. Sync Friday 09:30 UTC.

emma_prod: Reached out to top 5 noisy clients, flagged recommended fixes.

josh_oncall: PR for alert changes and paging config coming today. Marking WIP.

priya_sre: If the canary reduces pages by >65% over 48h we close short-term follow-ups. Otherwise reconvene and escalate.
